Subject Two German seamen missing - Request by German Consulate-General

Made by D.S.I. Wittinsky Forwarded by Supt. Mason.

In accordance with the instructions of Deputy Commissioner
(Special Branch) exhaustive and discreet enquiries were made
by the undersigned as to the whereabouts of K.H.H. Effert and
H.J. Rechlin when the following information was gleaned :-

In November 1938 three German-Aryans named :-
(1) Karl Heinrich Hermann Effert, age 25, single, radio
engineer,
(2) Hans Joachim Rechlin, age 20, single, seaman, and
(3) Arthur Hans Walter Hintze, age 22, single, barber,
who have political views in opposition to the Nazi regime and
who were about to be mobilized and recruited, fled from Berlin
to Amsterdam (Netherlands). There they became acquainted
with one named Heinrich Hans, German, age 26, a deserter from
the German Army. After a stay of about four months in Amsterdam,
they learned, that the German Authorities were taking steps
through their Consular representative to extradite them to
Germany. Having provided themselves with "stateless" passports,
the four of them decided to make their way to the Far East
arriving in Singapore in April 1939. From there they proceeded
to Bangkok where, after a brief stay of about a week, they
proceeded to Saigon and from where they arrived in Shanghai in
June 1939 aboard the s.s. "Athos II". Upon arrival here they
registered with the International Committee for the Organization
of European Immigrants In China and were placed into the Kinchow
Road Camp.

About three months later, Hintze obtained employment in
a barber shop at 226 Broadway and went to live at 24 Yunchang
Road together with Rechlin. Effert was, in the meantime,

由特别调查员维廷斯基（Wittinsky）呈报，经梅森（Mason）警司转呈。

遵照副总监（特别处）的指示，具名者对 K.H.H. 埃弗特（Effert）和 H.J. 雷希林（Rechlin）的下落进行了详尽且谨慎的调查，搜集到如下信息：

1938年11月，三名持反纳粹政权政治观点、即将被动员征召的德意志雅利安人：
(1) 卡尔·海因里希·赫尔曼·埃弗特（Karl Heinrich Hermann Effert），25岁，未婚，无线电工程师，
(2) 汉斯·约阿希姆·雷希林（Hans Joachim Rechlin），20岁，未婚，海员，以及
(3) 阿瑟·汉斯·瓦尔特·欣策（Arthur Hans Walter Hintze），22岁，未婚，理发师，
从柏林逃往阿姆斯特丹（荷兰）。在那里，他们结识了一位名叫海因里希·汉斯（Heinrich Hans）的德国人，26岁，系德国军队逃兵。在阿姆斯特丹停留约四个月后，他们得知德国当局正通过其领事代表采取步骤将他们引渡回德国。在弄到“无国籍”护照后，这四人决定前往远东，于1939年4月抵达新加坡。随后他们前往曼谷，短暂停留约一周后，又前往西贡，并于1939年6月乘坐“阿托斯二号”（Athos II）轮抵达上海。抵沪后，他们在“在华欧洲移民组织国际委员会”登记，并被安置进锦州路难民营。

大约三个月后，欣策在百老汇路226号的一家理发店找到工作，并与雷希林一同搬至运昌路24号居住。与此同时，埃弗特正在

德国领事馆，被告知他们即将被遣返，并应于1940年5月20日上午前来领取护照和车票。因此，他们在指定日期前往领事馆，领取了护照、车票及21.00美元旅费，并奉命于下午1点到达北站，届时德国领事馆的布劳韦勒（Brauweiler）先生将前往送行。然而，埃弗特和雷希林并未出现，前者收拾好行李后，匆忙从住所搬往一个未知的目的地（据信是法租界），而雷希林向德国领事官员提供了一个虚假地址（百老汇路426号），他一直留在平凉路1090号，直到1940年5月23日逃离，据信也在法租界寻求庇护。

根据获得的信息，雷希林逃跑的原因是：1940年5月23日上午，三名欧洲平民（* D.9522(e) 据信是“盖世太保”特工）在两名日本宪兵的陪同下，来到平凉路1090号，询问雷希林的下落。

进一步获悉的情况表明，埃弗特已于1940年5月21日通过挂号信将船票退回德国领事馆，而雷希林的船票则由 H. 汉斯于1940年5月23日在北京路2号交给了一名德国领事馆官员，汉斯随即离开该处，未透露其身份。然而，这两人保留了21美元的旅费。

Subject. Two German seamen missing - request by German Consulate-General.

Made by... and Forwarded by D. I. Crawford

Mr. Franz Brauweiler, Secretary of the German Consulate General, came to Headquarters on May 21st 1940 and was interviewed by D.I. Crawford.

He intimated that he was desirous of having the Police discreetly trace the whereabouts of two German merchant seamen who had disappeared while in Shanghai. The following particulars were furnished by Mr. Brauweiler:-

Those two seamen, (1) Karl Heinrich Hermann Effert, age 35, of medium height and build, dark hair, brown eyes and long face, lately living at House 53, Lane 245 Pingliang Road, and (2) Hanne Joachim Rechlin, age 20, medium height and build, dark hair, brown eyes and oval face, lately residing at 426 Broadway, had been called to the German Consulate on May 19th and issued with passports No. 247/40 and No. 248/40, respectively, (in their names), together with two railway tickets for Berlin via Siberia. The railway tickets costing G.$230.00 were issued by the Union Steamship Co. (Intourist) and were routed Shanghai, Nanking, Dairen. Those two men were then instructed to leave Shanghai (North Railway Station) at 2 p.m., May 20th where they would be met by a consular official to see they boarded the train, but they never appeared at the North Station. The passports in their possession are valid for three months from 27.4.40. Both men

德国总领事馆秘书弗朗茨·布劳韦勒（Franz Brauweiler）先生于1940年5月21日来到总部，由克劳福德侦探督察进行了问询。

他表示希望警方谨慎地追查两名在上海失踪的德国商船海员的下落。布劳韦勒先生提供了以下详情：

这两名海员，(1) 卡尔·海因里希·赫尔曼·埃弗特，35岁，中等身材，黑发，褐眼，长脸，最近居住在平凉路245弄53号，以及 (2) 汉内·约阿希姆·雷希林（Hanne Joachim Rechlin），20岁，中等身材，黑发，褐眼， oval face（椭圆脸），最近居住在百老汇路426号，曾于5月19日被召至德国领事馆，并分别签发了以其名义开具的第247/40号和第248/40号护照，以及两张经西伯利亚前往柏林的火车票。这些价值国币230.00元的火车票由联合轮船公司（Intourist，即苏联国际旅行社）签发，路线为上海、南京、大连。随后，这两人奉命于5月20日下午2点离开上海（北站），届时将有一名领事官员前往确保他们登上火车，但他们从未出现在北站。他们持有的护照自1940年4月27日起三个月内有效。两人均
